adaptations: Merge the upstream plugin's eleven skills into one Astravia skill (see docs/adr/qiushi-skill/0004-single-skill-with-internal-routing.md).

Entry SKILL.md (upstream skills/arming-thought/SKILL.md): rename frontmatter name to the package slug, rewrite description for single-entry triggering, turn routing targets into paths under references/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, add a 'how to read these' section. All other prose unchanged.
Downstream playbooks are stored as references/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, byte-identical to upstream SKILL.md; renamed so no recursive scan registers them as separate skills.

Add the Astravia-required version field to the entry SKILL.md frontmatter plus market presentation and provenance files (ability.json, detail.json, detail.zh.json, NOTICE.md, README files, upstream.json).
Derive the card icon from the upstream project mark assets/logo_main.png by scaling only.

Sub-agent prompts (agents/*.md) are kept as role briefs under agents/: drop model: inherit, rebase reference paths to references/skills/<name>/, and add a dispatch note, because Astravia does not auto-register agents shipped inside a skill package.

The upstream docs/index.html is rewritten as an offline page at assets/preview/index.html, with docs/assets/qiushi.png and shishiqiushi.png copied beside it; analytics, external fonts, badges, repository and community links and upstream install instructions are removed, the install section is replaced with the Astravia flow, and docs/assets/tangping_editorial_perspective.md is not shipped.

New scripts/ carry the operational side: open-preview.sh and open-preview.ps1 open the local page, verify-package.mjs checks routing targets and resource references offline, and sync-upstream.mjs drives this ledger against the upstream repository at the pinned commit without cloning it (local checkouts remain supported through --upstream).

README.md and README.zh.md are rewritten from the upstream READMEs: keep the introductions, structure, method tables, quotations and attribution; drop upstream distribution and install paths (npm CLI, Claude Code marketplace, per-host directories), badges, star history and community links; add this package's install, local checks and upstream sync. Placeholder install commands are replaced by the Astravia flow.

Add tests/ mirroring the upstream tests/ directory but checking this market entry instead of the Claude Code plugin: package identity and routing targets, the stored page being fully offline, and the provenance ledger. Upstream validate.sh / validate.ps1 are not migrated because half of their checks cover hooks, commands and .claude-plugin, which this package does not ship.
sync-upstream.mjs accepts --repository to check a mirror or fork of the same commit; the ledger stays the default.

Do not ship the upstream installer CLI (bin/): it resolves an npm package name and a GitHub coordinate, neither of which exists in this package. Its copy-and-ledger behaviour is reimplemented in scripts/install-platforms.mjs against scripts/platforms.json, with no network and no dependencies.

Include hooks/ (SessionStart) and commands/ (ten slash-command templates) after all: the Astravia host does have a SessionStart engine and reads hooks/hooks.json. Only the injection path changes, from skills/arming-thought/SKILL.md to the package-root SKILL.md, which is this package's replacement for that upstream entry.

commands/*.md keep upstream wording; only the target path changes, from `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` to `references/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`. They are inert in Astravia, which has no slash-command channel.

docs/platforms.md is rewritten as PLATFORMS.md / PLATFORMS.zh.md: drop the npx workflow, the plugin-marketplace commands and the per-host native installers, and point at scripts/install-platforms.mjs instead.

docs/assets/tangping_editorial_perspective.md is reproduced verbatim as references/cases/tangping-editorial-perspective.md, with a statements-in-reference/cases/README.md. It is a third-party case study, not market copy.

runtime.note: Installed skill: plain Markdown, never calls the network. scripts/sync-upstream.mjs is maintenance-only and does fetch the pinned commit.
